missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Основание' is the neuter nominative as the subject of 'есть'. 'Серьёзное' is the agreeing neuter adjective, and 'для этого' frames the reason.
Strategic focus: Genitive under negation. 'Основания' is the genitive form triggered by the negated verb 'не вижу'. 'Никакого' agrees in the genitive, strengthening the denial.
Strategic focus: Genitive after не иметь. 'Основания' is the genitive object of the negated 'не имеет', a fixed pattern. 'Это решение' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'На основании' uses the prepositional form after 'на' to show what the house stands on. 'Прочном' agrees in the neuter prepositional.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Основанию' is the dative form required by 'доверять', which governs the dative. 'Этому' agrees in the neuter dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after гордиться. 'Основанием' is the instrumental form required by 'гордиться'. 'Своим' agrees in the neuter instrumental, marking possession.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after нет. 'Оснований' is the genitive plural required by 'нет'. 'Твёрдых' agrees in the genitive plural, and 'у нас' frames the possession.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Основания' is the nominative plural as the subject of 'кажутся'. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'убедительными' is the instrumental predicate.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Основание' is the neuter accusative direct object of 'привели', identical to the nominative. 'Важное' agrees in the neuter accusative.
Strategic focus: Prepositional in a set phrase. 'На основании' is a fixed expression meaning on the basis of, governing the genitive 'закона'. A common formal connector.
